# Reese Hollister | Program, Research & Education Portfolio

> Reese Hollister's professional portfolio brings together university student support, writing consultation, international research, educational product development, and public history.

Reese holds a Master of International Studies from NC State University (2026), completed a Fulbright research year in Morocco (2023–24), and is a CRLA Level III writing consultant. The portfolio documents completed work and clearly distinguishes proposed processes from demonstrated outcomes.

## Professional portfolio
- [Home](https://reesehollister.com/): Complex work, made clear and useful.
- [Experience](https://reesehollister.com/experience/): University course support, writing consultation, teaching, international research, product development, and public scholarship.
- [Selected Work](https://reesehollister.com/projects/): Case studies with objectives, contributions, deliverables, and evidence.
- [About](https://reesehollister.com/about/): Background, education, and fieldwork.
- [Resume](https://reesehollister.com/resume/): Professional overview and an email request for a current resume.
- [Contact](https://reesehollister.com/contact/): Professional inquiries and collaboration.
